Tatshia overruns the defensive holdfasts of Laqitupata, annexing the town and its fertile environs from SurahaTawantin.
Following fierce fighting along the fortifications, Chasuchi surrenders to Tatshia; its magistrates swear fealty as SurahaTawantin's banner is hauled down.
Garrisons of Tatshia storm the ramparts of Wula, driving out the defenders of SurahaTawantin and hoisting their triumphant colors.
The banners of Tatshia are raised over Chuwacha as victorious cohorts march in, ending SurahaTawantin's dominion over the district.
The banners of Tatshia are raised over Chuwacha as victorious cohorts march in, ending Tatshia's dominion over the district.
Garrisons of Tatshia storm the ramparts of Hiwuwipampa, driving out the defenders of SurahaTawantin and hoisting their triumphant colors.
The walls of Vegchegorod crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Zowuwe breach the defenses of Vegchegorod's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.

The Hundred Days War of Rege reaches its conclusion after 3 years of bloodshed: Tunöstan & Darabad & Tatshia & Dun Rachys & Vulsebkhuv & Beskodstan triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Humbled, Principality of SurahaTawantin bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Tunöstan, paying yearly tribute.

ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Dictated at swordpoint by Tunöstan, the old institutions of Confederation of Rege are dismantled! The defeated realm is reorganized into the Principality of Rege under a new constitutional treaty.
Bethråy of Nøblosfjord turns from the old cause toward the safety of the holdfast.
The bells of Nøblosfjord toll for the passing of Yulsemjem the Peacemaker Wembow'om (a hunting accident). The youth Bethråy ascends the throne under a regency council.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal cap levies and noble exploitation, the laborers of Mibbu rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Nøblosfjord, they establish the People's Republic of Mibbu with Yebyullele leading the commune.
Yebyullele is acclaimed ruler of People's Republic of Mibbu.

Outraged by treason, the crown of Workers' Federation of Nøblosfjord mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in People's Republic of Mibbu. The Invasion of Mibbu begins in fire and iron.
Mübulö (Master Artisan) composes an immortal ballad that brings tears to commoners and kings alike in Kheje.
Ñata (Master Artificer) engineers a revolutionary watermill mechanism that doubles grain milling yields in Wula.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Bassagpada storm the government palace in SurahaTawantin! The faction seizes control, establishing the Free Trading Cities of SurahaTawantin.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Covert saboteurs from Begvedhys detonate powder stores in SurahaTawantin, gutting frontline regiments!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Begvedhys are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in SurahaTawantin!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Darabad stir mutiny among garrison troops in Toiguo!

ARCANE MELTDOWN: Unstable alchemy and runaway leyline containment experiments detonate violently near Arcane Proving Grounds of Cell 2505! Magical shockwaves scorch the earth into irradiated ash, collapsing towers and displacing hundreds.
QUEST COMPLETED: Liberation of the Captive Sage in Tudupatna! Gakzih successfully frees the captive, escorting them to safety and earning 100 Gold in grateful tribute!
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Zhayfos pave the Vekhmishahr-Pilduzhpop Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Vekhmishahr and Pilduzhpop (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Niyang pave the Niyang-Shegsheh Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Niyang and Shegsheh (+trade, +stability).

The Hundred Days War of Rege is known as the Great Reckoning among the Kherö, and as the Plunder among the Mokebu.
River Blessing Day: Bonfires on the hills of Beta Qusho greet the high sun above Nidusum.
Ballgame of the Hero Twins: Warriors of Mibbu parade and wrestle in the squares of Mibbu to honour the old victories.
Envoys from SurahaTawantin and Rege exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Neither camp can break the front: envoys sign a mutual cessation of hostilities, ending the Invasion of Mibbu (1 year) in an uneasy truce.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Kød take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Nøblosfjord, they hoist republican banners beneath Nunmøs to establish the United Provinces of Pydbemrike.
Nunmøs is acclaimed ruler of United Provinces of Pydbemrike.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Workers' Federation of Nøblosfjord marches swiftly upon United Provinces of Pydbemrike. The drums of the Conquest of Pydbemrike echo across the provinces.
Konwowa (Philosopher) drafts a universal legal code that enhances provincial stability in Pohvekhkand.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Nøblosfjord! Fuppåm seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Principality of Nøblosfjord!
CONSTITUTIONAL REFORM: Sovereign and citizens forge a historic concordat in Rege! Relinquishing autocratic rule, the state formally reconstitutes as the Free Commonwealth of Rege.

STATE ATHEISM PROCLAIMED: The revolutionary leadership in Rege enacts Radical Secularization! State religion is abolished, temple estates and monastery vaults are confiscated for the people (+65 gold), and ancient dogma is suppressed.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Tatshia stir mutiny among garrison troops in Pydbemrike!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Vulsebkhuv stir mutiny among garrison troops in Brona!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Cou are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Kusmitabad!

QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Yuha embarks upon the Deliverance of the High Scholar in Khomabu! Yuha gathers scouts and infiltrates the frontier redoubts near Khomabu to pinpoint the captive's cell.

monsters.name: The Frost-Maned Guardian
monsters.lore: A colossal pale tiger of snow-clad ridges, silent as autumn wind, that warbands speak of only in whispers.

monsters.name: Abyssal Terror
monsters.lore: A colossal multi-tentacled sea monster capable of pulling entire armadas down into the black abyss.

monsters.name: The Great Calydonian Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Behemoth the Earth-Shaker
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: The Radiant Sovereign
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: Tepegöz the One-Eyed
monsters.lore: A one-eyed giant of the steppe epics, slain only by a hero clever enough to blind him.

monsters.name: The Each-uisge of the Loch
monsters.lore: A water horse that lets riders mount, then plunges into the loch with them stuck fast.

monsters.name: Kappa of the Reed Pools
monsters.lore: A water imp with a dish of water on its head; bow to it, and courtesy forces it to bow back and spill its strength.

monsters.name: Bakunawa the Moon-Eater
monsters.lore: A great sea serpent that rises to swallow the moon; villagers drive it back by banging pots and pans until it spits the moon out.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

Something vast stirs in the lightless depths beneath Iyghuyk; the deep wardens double their watch.
A warm current sweeps past Nopsum'u; shoals of silver fish and drifting pearls enrich Nopsum'u.
Lohyapy squeezes the shaft-tolls of Qasr Fatsiq; the miners of Ze'olyat mutter beneath the stone.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Zuyeh bars the shaft to Luswuj, and the tithe-collectors of Luswuj are turned back at the lamps of Ze'olyat.
TAX REVOLT: the undercity of Loolruyx bars the shaft to Qasr Tub, and the tithe-collectors of Lohyapy are turned back at the lamps of Ze'olyat.
The Border War of Wichtiw is known as the Unification among the I'olryoqheur, and as the Subjugation among the Tapsay.
The Invasion of Ra-kito is known as the Usurpation among the Mahidi, and as the Reclamation among the Pomome.
Feast of New Light: People of Lofzamin wake the year with song and fresh green boughs at Litshahr.
The walls of Fumome crumble under heavy assault! Cohorts of Sidywy breach the defenses of Fipopenui's capital, scattering the garrison and sacking the palace.
Ballgame of the Hero Twins: Warriors of Wina parade and wrestle in the squares of Ba'sakotoo to honour the old victories.
Envoys from Wenoki and Fipopenui exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
Envoys from Vuwo and Regybo exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.
The Conquest of Fipopenui reaches its conclusion after 4 years of bloodshed: Sidywy & Caer Wenohy triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Humbled, Holy See of Fipopenui bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Sidywy, paying yearly tribute.
Topina of Sidywy wins the glory sought in the Conquest of Fipopenui.
Lihu of Caer Wenohy wins the glory sought in the Conquest of Fipopenui.

ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Dictated at swordpoint by Sidywy, the old institutions of Holy See of Fipopenui are dismantled! The defeated realm is reorganized into the Commercial Union of Fipopenui under a new constitutional treaty.
Kiwoko of Wenoki takes up the cause of knowledge.
In the royal halls of Wenoki, Sewuti Open-Hand  breathes their last, succumbing to a wasting sickness. Kiwoko ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.
A'ytxaoza of O'irzaet comes to the throne bent on a lasting legacy.
A perilous interregnum grips O'irzaet following the heirless death of Ho'uqzuax (old age). Retainers of House Ghu'ixxuah storm the assembly and usurp the crown.
A blazing crimson comet arcs across the night skies above Izyloth; court astrologers dispute whether it foretells glorious conquest or catastrophic ruin.
COUP D'ETAT: Armed regiments loyal to Rosu storm the government palace in Wenoki! The faction seizes control, establishing the Protectorate of Wenoki.
COVERT INTRIGUE: Agitators dispatched by Pewpassip stir mutiny among garrison troops in Wina!

OVER-FARMING DUST BOWL: Decades of intensive cultivation and overgrazing exhaust the arid topsoil around the hinterlands of Ix-jelalu. Violent dust storms sweep the plains, suffocating crops and forcing herders into exile.
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Tungi embarks upon the Recovery of the Chant Staff of Kilumopu! Tungi hears that the carved staff that holds the genealogy chant of Kilumopu was lost in a storm.

NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Lohyapy pave the Shuvmih-Pu'jetk'in Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Shuvmih and Pu'jetk'in (+trade, +stability).

A catastrophic blow to Mogewy: legions of Luwia overrun the citadel of Caer Bele, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
The final citadels fall, and the crown of Free Union of Mogewy is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Sowysu Tolu flees into bitter exile as the holdfast fades into legend.
The Luwia–Mogewy War reaches its conclusion after 1 year of bloodshed: Luwia triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Feast of the Pilgrim Caravan: Granaries of Sarwil are opened at Al-mumfat; the whole town eats until dusk.
Envoys from Sidywy and Vuwo exchange solemn vows of mutual defense, binding their courts in a grand alliance.

Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Free Trading Cities of O'irzaet launches a determined invasion into High Realm of Bilad Baq, igniting the O'irzaet Succession War. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Vuwo rally to Bilad Baq's side.
Denouncing ancient covenants, the heralds of Free Union of Te Hemuro proclaim war upon Commercial Union of Ja'jecajaw. Trumpets sound across the frontier as the Ja'jecajaw Campaign begins.
Losudu II of Sidywy takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
The bells of Sidywy toll for the passing of Watyimshaj Lionheart Shiysar (old age). The youth Losudu ascends the throne under a regency council.
Laltamlech of Seltey comes to the throne bent on the safety of the holdfast.
In the royal halls of Seltey, Chetlwan the Timid Paltalliy breathes their last, succumbing to a wasting sickness. Laltamlech ascends the ancestral throne amid solemn acclamation.
Safa of Sovusa swears vengeance on Tinunero for the sack of Sovusa.
The death of Rololy Sugemybobu (a fall from a horse) leaves Sovusa without an acknowledged heir. In the ensuing succession crisis, House Nylyfywasury seizes the high throne amidst palace turmoil.
Ho'uqzuax of Ze'olyat takes up the cause of the spread of the faith.
The bells of Ze'olyat toll for the passing of Zi'uqhyer Open-Hand Y'ihuighryit (a fall from a horse). The youth Ho'uqzuax ascends the throne under a regency council.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Declaring citizen liberty inviolable, the populace of Wulivach casts out imperial governors! Renouncing allegiance to Luwia, Tiveru proclaims the sovereign Free Commonwealth of Lorogiwy.
Tiveru is acclaimed ruler of Free Commonwealth of Lorogiwy.
Vowing to eradicate rebellion, Empire of Luwia marches swiftly upon Free Commonwealth of Lorogiwy. The drums of the War of Luwia echo across the provinces.
Ngorona (Master Artificer) invents an ingenious optical telescope to survey distant constellations in Fumovi.
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Saypan! Waylal seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Military Junta of Saypan!
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Reme! Hotunelu seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Grand Marshalate of Reme!
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by Kohe strike at midnight in Womokawa! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Merchant League of Womokawa!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Clandestine agents from Jese sow suspicion in the frontier councils of Chu'jeha.
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Wenoki are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Caer Wenohy!
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Simbiqa embarks upon the Rescue of the Lost Caravan Near Fekhlezbehy! Simbiqa hears that a pilgrim caravan has missed its well and is overdue near Fekhlezbehy.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Pana pave the Ix-po'chu-Fewamotu Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Ix-po'chu and Fewamotu (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Hokebu pave the Hewu-We'tatun Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Hewu and We'tatun (+trade, +stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Undina of the Silver Basin purifies the sacred rivers of Nenubonape! Abundant fish and unhindered river trade enrich the townships (+30 gold, +12 stability).
PATRON MIRACLE: Zephyros the Sky-Sovereign hurls deafening thunderbolts across the frontiers of Vuwo, scattering hostile vanguards with righteous gales (+15% army power).
RUINOUS GIFT: Khorvath the Blood Lord floods the warriors of Lohyapy with bloodthirsty slaughter! Mortal legions butcher foes with demonic savagery (+25% army power, -8 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Khorvath the Blood Lord floods the warriors of Uhquyk with bloodthirsty slaughter! Mortal legions butcher foes with demonic savagery (+25% army power, -8 stability).
RUINOUS GIFT: Luxuria the Gilded Prince intoxicates the high courts of Ja'jecajaw with exquisite hedonism! Opulence surges alongside reckless decadence (+40 gold, -10 stability).
The vault-born Facuwa clears the tunnels under Sovusa of mutant swarms; the people call them Warden.
Unrest of the year: tax riots in Tisigumeru (Wenoki).

The Lantern School of Pewpassip finds patrons in Te Numa.
In Rowomudi the Sober Brotherhood gathers crowds behind Yoremuwinoku Yuri, demanding temperance for Wenoki.
In Regybo, the cause of emancipation takes root among the bondsfolk, demanding an end to bondage.
A warm current sweeps past Nopsum'u; shoals of silver fish and drifting pearls enrich Nopsum'u.
Bizuwu throws off the yoke of Ra-kito and declares its independence.
SKY BLOCKADE: the floating hosts of Duhar close the air-lanes above Fumowitu, starving Wafo of the high trade.
TITAN REAWAKENING: After centuries of primordial slumber, the immortal The Celestial Raptor (Ziz) awakens in Wilds beyond Sokuha! Its primeval fury shakes the continent.

monsters.name: Vermithrax Flameseeker
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: The Radiant Sovereign
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: The Great Calydonian Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: Behemoth the Earth-Shaker
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: Glacies the Glacial Drake
monsters.lore: A frost-breathing great wyrm dwelling in glacial crevasses, freezing rivers solid with a single exhalation.

monsters.name: The Dune-Shadow Roc
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: The Celestial Raptor
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: The Emerald Qilin
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: The River Kappa
monsters.lore: A water imp with a dish of water on its head; bow to it, and courtesy forces it to bow back and spill its strength.

monsters.name: The Black Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.name: The Ahuizotl of the Lake
monsters.lore: A water dog with a hand at the end of its tail that drags fishermen beneath the lake.

monsters.name: The Forest Sasabonsam
monsters.lore: A long-legged forest being that dangles from the canopy to snatch the careless traveller.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.

Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Free Commonwealth of Ninsik mobilizes its hosts against Protectorate of Novevo. Banners unfurl for the Great Ninsik War.
Ambition stirs in the courts of Syndicate of Dicigopatna, which openly claims dominion over Grand Duchy of Rupuka. The holdfast braces as the Great Dicigopatna War erupts.
Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Empire of Kiwa launches a determined invasion into Free Trading Cities of Yowayu, igniting the Border War of Yowayu.
Rahaba of Turabad takes up the cause of glory.
A perilous interregnum grips Turabad following the heirless death of Buha (old age). Retainers of House Qishujafuwu storm the assembly and usurp the crown.

AGRARIAN REVOLT: Crushed by feudal cap levies and noble exploitation, the laborers of Japeni rise in open insurrection! Renouncing the lords of Rapshatbiy, they establish the Workers' Federation of Japeni with Pope leading the commune.
Pope is acclaimed ruler of Workers' Federation of Japeni.
Seeking to restore imperial order by force, Artificer Directorate of Rapshatbiy dispatches punitive legions to subdue Workers' Federation of Japeni. The bitter Border War of Japeni is underway.
COUP D'ETAT: Mutinous conspirators led by A'puwa strike at midnight in Rupe! The revolutionary council seizes control, overthrowing the sovereign and proclaiming the Principality of Rupe!
COUP D'ETAT: A sudden palace putsch overthrows the established order in Prapre! Trorlifla seizes control amidst martial decrees, proclaiming the Commercial Union of Prapre!
DIPLOMATIC SCANDAL: Envoys of Lesecigarh are expelled after their covert spies are unmasked in Rupe!
COVERT INTRIGUE: Assassins from Yitekab strike in the dead of night, slaying Buytaydash in the court of Meykan!

ARCANE MELTDOWN: Unstable alchemy and runaway leyline containment experiments detonate violently near Arcane Proving Grounds of Cell 181! Magical shockwaves scorch the earth into irradiated ash, collapsing towers and displacing hundreds.
QUEST UNDERTAKEN: Biseda embarks upon the Saving the Terraces of Pekeniniwo Before the Rains! Biseda hears that the terrace walls above Pekeniniwo are cracking just before the planting season.
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Yobefuni pave the Yobefuni-Nojewi Silk Highway, establishing a direct route between Yobefuni and Nojewi (+trade, +stability).
NEW HIGHWAY: Engineers of Diveshu pave the Yuhupatna-Dadasho Royal Road, establishing a direct route between Yuhupatna and Dadasho (+trade, +stability).
NATURE BLESSING: Ignis the Hearth Caldera stokes the caldera hearths of Meyrut! Master smiths forge shimmering obsidian weaponry bathed in magma (+16% army power, +15 gold).

ELDRITCH MANIFESTATION: Nyxal the Void Dreamer projects psychic void-whispers into the foes of Nuja! Invaders flee in weeping delirium, haunted by visions of tentacled cosmic voids (+18% army power, -7 stability).

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Talget take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Meyrut, they hoist republican banners beneath Daysar to establish the Free Commonwealth of Betdesh.

A catastrophic blow to Japeni: legions of Rapshatbiy overrun the citadel of Japeni, seizing the royal seat and routing the high council.
Banners trampled and throne abandoned, Protectorate of Novevo ceases to exist as a sovereign power. Hika Vafevo flees the ashes of their former dominion.
The Great Ninsik War reaches its conclusion after less than a year of bloodshed: Ninsik & Panga & Nerine triumph decisively, forcing a humiliating treaty upon their foes.
Feast of the Harvest Drums: Granaries of Wage are opened at Ka-gago; the whole town eats until dusk.

Old border feuds boil over into open bloodshed: Scavenger Compact of Sakfahabad launches a determined invasion into Empire of Rupuka, igniting the Conquest of Rupuka. Pledging mutual defense, the levies of Diveshu rally to Rupuka's side.
A victor's peace is forged: after 1 year of campaign in the Border War of Japeni, Rapshatbiy prevail, annexing contested borderlands.
Humbled, Workers' Federation of Japeni bends the knee and becomes a vassal of Rapshatbiy, paying yearly tribute.
ENFORCED REGIME CHANGE: Victorious armies from Rapshatbiy mandate total political reorganization in Japeni! Overthrowing the vanquished elite, they inaugurate the Artificer Directorate of Japeni.

STATE ATHEISM PROCLAIMED: The revolutionary leadership in Japeni enacts Radical Secularization! State religion is abolished, temple estates and monastery vaults are confiscated for the people (+65 gold), and ancient dogma is suppressed.

The Invasion of Tuta is known as the War of Deliverance in Turabad, and as the Years of Ash in Tuta.
TITAN REAWAKENING: After centuries of primordial slumber, the immortal The Timingila of the Deep (Timingila) awakens in Wilds beyond Pongayu! Its primeval fury shakes the continent.
Ninsik overruns the defensive holdfasts of Serrap, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Meykan.

The final citadels fall, and the crown of Protectorate of Choslow is broken forever. With treasuries emptied and borders dissolved, Pabyakyav Dupyavyih flees into bitter exile as the holdfast fades into legend.
Rice Blessing: Granaries of Hingyuwadi are opened at Hingyuwadi; the whole town eats until dusk.
Ninsik overruns the defensive holdfasts of Nishcit, annexing the town and its fertile environs from Meykan.
Garrisons of Ninsik storm the ramparts of Cashdibpatna, driving out the defenders of Meykan and hoisting their triumphant colors.
Families of Gabu and LoozR' marry across the border; the Nguronisipu and Ro'itheigh folk grow closer.
With swords drawn and ancient pacts invoked, Democratic Union of Hingyuwadi marches against Popular Commonwealth of Prana. The War of Hingyuwadi begins.
Citing border encroachments and bitter territorial grievances, Republic of Turabad mobilizes its hosts against Syndicate of Tuta. Banners unfurl for the Border War of Tuta.
White banners flutter over the war camps. The War of Hingyuwadi ends in mutual exhaustion after less than a year; borders return to former lines.
Kanona of Begvedhys Beyond takes up the cause of glory.
The reign of Pebimo II the Peaceful Kowabomike in Begvedhys Beyond concludes with their death (fever). Kanona takes up the royal mantle, vowing to defend the holdfast.

REPUBLICAN REVOLT: Weary of monarchical tyranny, the burghers and civic guilds of Tutate take up arms for freedom! Seceding from Vlofro, they hoist republican banners beneath Rafewu to establish the United Provinces of Tutate.
Rafewu is acclaimed ruler of United Provinces of Tutate.
Outraged by treason, the crown of Republic of Vlofro mobilizes imperial cohorts to crush the upstart insurrection in United Provinces of Tutate. The Vlofro–Tutate War begins in fire and iron.
Philosopher Ji'ka of Li'lowuk'in achieves worldwide acclaim with their magnum opus: "The Principles of Commonwealth".
Simrifbid (Philosopher) publishes a groundbreaking philosophical treatise that inspires court reforms in Mansiw.
Ma'moba (Philosopher) calculates the true circumference of the world from tower shadows in Li'wuwocho.
Deshgagi (Grand Champion) sets an unprecedented record in the sprint and javelin throwing trials in Vutlan.
Jajduba (Master Artisan) completes a cathedral ceiling fresco celebrating the history of the holdfast in Fumjib.

monsters.name: Titan of the Steppes
monsters.lore: A colossal terrestrial colossus whose bones are tubes of bronze and limbs like bars of iron, roaming ancient grasslands.

monsters.name: Lion of the Golden Dawn
monsters.lore: An immortal noble lion with a mane of radiant sunlight, whose majestic roar dispels dark enchantments.
monsters.trophy: Solar Lion Mane of Golden Light

monsters.name: Vermithrax Flameseeker
monsters.lore: An ancient volcanic dragon sleeping atop mountains of melted gold, reducing invading armies to calcined bones.

monsters.name: Ziz the Storm-Sovereign
monsters.lore: A colossal winged terror of celestial heights whose wingspan eclipses the noon sun and commands cyclones.

monsters.name: Shadow of the Loch
monsters.lore: An elusive plesiosaur-like lake cryptid spoken of in local campfire folklore, surfacing only when mists veil the waters.

monsters.name: Roc the Sky-Render
monsters.lore: The roc of sailors' and caravaneers' tall tales, a bird vast enough to carry off an elephant; its wingbeats raise dust storms over the canyons.

monsters.name: Iron-Hide Boar
monsters.lore: A massive armored tusker leading wild forest herds, tearing up farmland and trampling watchtowers.
monsters.trophy: Calydonian Boar Great Tusks & Armored Hide

monsters.name: The Auspicious Horned Beast
monsters.lore: A gentle horned dragon-beast cloaked in scales of jade, appearing only during the reigns of benevolent and enlightened rulers.

monsters.name: The Black Cadejo
monsters.lore: Spectral dogs of the night roads: the white one guards travellers, the black one leads them astray.

monsters.name: The River Ninki Nanka
monsters.lore: A dragon of the mangrove swamps; it is said that to see it is to fall ill.

monsters.name: The Ponaturi of the Reef
monsters.lore: Hostile sea goblins of the old hero tales who sleep beneath the waves by day and come ashore at night; sunlight destroys them.

monsters.name: The Timingila of the Deep
monsters.lore: A sea monster of the old epics so vast it swallows whales whole, and is itself swallowed by something larger still.

artifacts.lore: Sun-forged Shard of Vatgak: A fabled relic held by Meyrut, granting renown across the realms.

wonders.effect: +20 Realm Stability and attracts pilgrims and valiant champions from foreign lands.

species.name: Human
species.desc: Versatile and ambitious mortals who build sprawling empires across every continent.

species.name: Elf
species.desc: Graceful, long-lived beings attuned to primal magic, ancient forests, and stellar harmonies.

species.name: Dwarf
species.desc: Stout, resolute masters of masonry, deep mining, and forged steel who carve citadels into living stone.

species.name: Orc
species.desc: Fierce, muscular warriors governed by martial honor, blood covenants, and relentless resilience.

species.name: Troll
species.desc: Massive, regenerative brutes of mossy crags and deep wetlands possessing primeval strength.

species.name: Beastman
species.desc: Prideful therianthropic folk bearing lupine, feline, or minotaur aspects, hunters of boundless wildlands.

species.name: Halfling
species.desc: Clever, jovial, and nimble folk who build peaceful pastoral burrows or intricate clockwork workshops.

species.name: Giant
species.desc: Colossal beings of primeval stone, frost, and storm, keeping ancient memory of the world's dawn.

species.name: Goblin
species.desc: Prolific, cunning, and resourceful tinkerers who thrive in shadowy crevices, mines, and scrap cities.

species.name: Dragonborn
species.desc: Scale-bound noble warriors descended from dragons, wielding elemental breath and stubborn pride.

species.name: Merfolk
species.desc: Aquatic humanoids of the coral reefs and sunlit shallows, rulers of the pelagic depths.

species.name: Starborn
species.desc: Luminous beings born of falling stars and astral conduits, radiating transcendent grace.

species.name: Ratfolk
species.desc: Cunning subterranean rodentkin and warpstone tinkerers who breed rapidly in foul under-empires.

species.name: Lizardfolk
species.desc: Cold-blooded ancient guardians of the geomantic web who defend temple-cities under primal mandates.

species.name: Tomb Revenant
species.desc: Ancient slumbering skeletal pharaohs and living-metal monarchs commanding eternal legions.

species.name: Ogor
species.desc: Massive nomadic brute warriors driven by eternal hunger and gut-magic across mountains and steppes.

species.name: Void Elf
species.desc: Ancient psychic wanderers of cosmic webways with spirit stones preserving souls against the void.

species.name: Warp Fiend
species.desc: Horned warp-manifestations born of cosmic fractures and excess emotion hungry for slaughter.

species.name: Chitin Swarm
species.desc: Synaptic bio-constructs with chittering carapaces driven by a devouring hive-mind.
